text.tspan: custom bus, timers, GPIO & UART verified on GHDL
Engineering 5 flagship systems across silicon, privacy browser & AI agents.

g.text: Complete Offline-First Desktop Environment & Application Suite
A complete local-first desktop application with integrated browser, encrypted notes, local calendar, media player,
documents vault, internet radio, weather, curated news feeds, file utilities, and zero-leak privacy controls.
Engineered for uncompromising privacy: native tracker protection, isolated session containers, fine-grained
permission controls, real-time privacy dashboard, secure download manager, and localized encrypted browsing history.
A lightweight coding AI runtime built to connect to local coding LLMs or external inference APIs. Operates directly
on real codebases with sandboxed tool execution, deterministic workspace mutation, and strict RAM footprints.
A high-performance media processing engine: lightning-fast video/audio conversion, modern compression algorithms,
deep metadata extraction, subtitle demuxing/generation, batch pipeline execution, and forensic container inspection.
Custom 32-Bit RISC-V Microcontroller SoC & RTL Subsystems
Complete custom 32-bit RISC-V microcontroller SoC: RV32I CPU core, boot ROM, SRAM controller, system bus, GPIO,
UART, SPI, I²C, hardware timers, nested interrupts, bare-metal C firmware support, GHDL simulation, and FPGA target.
Bare-Metal C • FPGA Synthesis • RV32I Assembly • SIMD (AVX2/NEON) • Encrypted SQLite • Linux Internals • GHDL Engine
